tasks.title: Fresh veggies
tasks.text: Time for fresh veggies: about a cup per pig, with something rich in vitamin C (bell pepper, parsley, kale).

tasks.title: Fresh water
tasks.text: Change the water and check that the bottle drips.

tasks.title: Hay top-up
tasks.text: Top up the hay. Guinea pigs should always have hay (it keeps their teeth short).

tasks.title: Quick clean
tasks.text: Remove wet bedding and poops from the favourite corners.

tasks.title: Weigh-in
tasks.text: Weekly weigh-in. Write down each pig's weight; a steady loss is an early sign of illness.

tasks.title: Big cage clean
tasks.text: Change all bedding and wash the bowls and the bottle.

tasks.title: Brushing
tasks.text: Brush the fur (long-haired pigs more often) and check the skin for flakes or bald spots.

tasks.title: Nail trim
tasks.text: Check the nails and trim them if they curl.

tasks.title: Vet check-up
tasks.text: Yearly check-up at a vet who knows guinea pigs (teeth, weight, skin).
